q: All my friends and relatives seem to be of the “loved being pregnant” camp.
cx: UK, 23+5, first-time mum; finding pregnancy unbelievably hard.

q: I feel like you don’t hear about miserable pregnancies much at all. I’m so grateful to be pregnant but man oh man it’s so much harder than I ever imagined!
I haven’t really had that 2nd trimester relief everyone talks about

I also had to cancel so much in the early weeks (especially because everyone told me I’d feel better after the first trimester) which unfortunately cost me some friendships with some not very understanding people that I have definitely become a bit of a hermit.
I’ve also had a lot of unhelpful “just you wait until you have a newborn” comments when I’ve talked about how I’m feeling to people (friends, family, even medical professionals!).
I’m a senior director in a financial services company and I’m genuinely convinced I’m going to ruin my job. My brain is just mush already!

I’d love to take early mat leave but I think future me will regret it when I have to leave our little one to return to work. I also really don’t want to reduce my hours too much as I’ve already lost a month’s pay due to being signed off for longer than our company sick leave policy allows
